The Bring-surface trilogarithm \mathrm{Li}_3^q admits a depth-3 cyclotomic witness. This categorical identity equates the trilogarithm at roots of unity to the q-trilogarithm evaluated at the substrate parameter.

This section conjectures the explicit depth-3 identity, identifies its cyclotomic specialisations, and verifies them empirically against CODATA-grade constants. The sequence uses the Tate-rational identification, the \zeta_5-orbit-sum, and PSLQ independence verification to isolate the genuinely new depth-3 content. The general \mathrm{Cl}_3 orbit-sum formula completes the trilogarithm substrate-flow data used by the spectral computations that follow.
